headline: Mr Overs Is Still On Top, But The Blazers Just Gave Him A Haircut And The Nets Are Trying To Finish Him
intro: Leon's still leading at +68.9, but he shed 55.5 points in a week and his lead has gone from a canyon to a decent-sized ditch. Dan had the week of the season (+81.1) and Angus had the opposite (−94.3), and with every team on 4–7 games, these numbers will swing like a barn door in a cyclone. The Grizzlies are 6–0 and the Nets are 0–5, which is a very expensive thing to know if you picked either of them wrong.

players.name: Leon
players.text: Still top at +68.9, but down 55.5 on the week. The Jazz Over at 1–5 is a −23.8 pit and the Nets Over at 0–5 is a −24.5 hole, so half his card is doing the Chinman impression of a man holding a lottery ticket. The Grizzlies Over at 6–0 (+52.5) is holding the whole thing up, and the Rockets thumped OKC to keep that Over healthy. Mr Overs showing optimism has merit, but this week it came with a bill.

players.name: Nic
players.text: Second at +41.7, down 27.3, and Visdog's card is a mixed bag. The Thunder Over is a worry: Jalen Williams is out with a leg fracture (roughly 53 games), Chet Holmgren is out about 26 games, and the Rockets just beat them 119–98. That's around six wins gone from his Over before we've hit November. The Kings Under (0–6, +21.5) and Knicks Under (+25.2) are doing the heavy lifting, but the Blazers Under at −23.1 is his Round 1 anchor, and Portland are 4–1.

players.name: Dan
players.text: Doccy had a ripper, +81.1 for the week, and sits third at +25.1 after a sneaky climb. The Suns Under (+20.0) is looking sweet with Mark Williams out until February, and the 76ers Over (+19.8) is cooking even with Embiid and LeBron out, because Maxey just dropped 38 to beat Charlotte. Bulls Over is the sore spot at 1–5 (−15.8), though Patrick Williams being back is a small lift. Nice week, mate, but in this comp a single −10 will kill ya, and he's got two or three lurking.

players.name: Angus
players.text: Oof. Gooey lost 94.3 points in a week and fell from the penthouse to fourth at +8.8. The Warriors Under took a 41-point bath, and the Pelicans Under (2–4) and Suns Over are both leaking, though that Suns Over is the sort of pick Mark Williams's shoulder surgery will keep leaking all season. The Raptors Over has Kawhi out until about 23 Nov, which is 11 games and around two wins. Silver lining: Jimmy Butler's knee surgery (back around 2 Jan, 26 games) is gold for his Warriors Under, so he can sit down and have a bit of a cry about it.

players.name: Roscoe the Dog
players.text: Roscoe sits fifth at +8.7 and had a decent week (+18.8) without lifting a paw, which is the most efficient way to play this comp. The Warriors Over is the problem child with Jimmy Butler out until early January, while the Heat Under (+19.2) and Hawks Over (−8.4, and they just got smashed 121–99 by the Pelicans) are a coin toss. The efficiency numbers say the dog is actually at +25.9, so he's been unlucky and probably deserves better. Don't tell Doc, it'll go to his head.

players.name: Ned
players.text: Ned climbed 33.5 on the week and is sixth at −5.8, which means he's still a Rockets Under at −22.8 and a Pistons Under at −18.8 away from respectability. Those two teams are 6–1 and 5–1 respectively and Houston just flogged the Thunder, so there's no help coming there. The good news is Thunder Under with Williams and Holmgren both out (roughly 6 wins at stake), and the Nets Under at 0–5 gives him a free +24.5. A promising week from Ned. If he continues this momentum, he might actually finish above zero!!

players.name: Harry
players.text: Harry's seventh at −10.6, up 18.7, and he'll be happy to see the Mavs 4–2 on a three-game win streak with Cooper Flagg and Caleb Martin back. The Mavericks Over (+20.2) is his best pick. The Wolves Under looks even better after Anthony Edwards went down with knee surgery (back around 21 Dec, 20 games) and Donte DiVincenzo's Achilles is out for the season. The Clippers Over (−14.1) and Magic Over (−10.7) are the bits stopping him from looking clever.

players.name: Marco
players.text: Marci's eighth at −25.8 and lost 46.3 on the week, which is a lot of points for a man who can't blame anyone but himself. The Mavs Under at −20.2 has Flagg back on the court and the Mavs on a roll, so that's a slow bleed. The Wolves Over has Edwards out for 20 games and DiVincenzo out for the year, around six wins at stake, so he's got a long winter ahead. The Cavs Over is the one bright spot, and with Mobley and Allen combining for 52 against the Bucks, it might even stay that way.

players.name: Sam
players.text: Sammy's ninth at −53.8, up 38.1 on the week, which is a nice rebound for a man bleeding out in a 76ers Under puddle (−19.8, and Philly are 6–1 without their two biggest names). The Knicks Over at 2–4 is −25.2, and the Pacers Over at 2–4 is −17.2 with Haliburton, Nembhard and Zubac all picking up knocks this week. Bulls Under is the lone bright spot at +15.8, though Patrick Williams being back is a small headwind. It's early, but his card is looking like a rental car at a music festival.

players.name: Pos
players.text: Pos holds the spoon at −56.2, and the Grizzlies Under is why: they're 6–0, they just beat Sacramento 136–105, and that pick is sitting at −52.5, which is an entire season's worth of regret. The Kings Over at 0–6 (−21.5) and Heat Over (−19.2) aren't helping, and the Jazz Under and Hawks Under are the only things stopping this from being a bloodbath. Reminder that the spoon winner gets Roscoe's shit, and with the Grizzlies still unbeaten, Pos might want to start practising his gag reflex.

signoff: May your unders tank and your overs thrive!
